# Kestrix

> Kestrix is an Apache-2.0 security project by Ruthvik Bandari. Its lead product, `kestrix-scan`, is a local,
> rule-based security scanner with no dependencies on Python 3.11 and newer: it finds insecure code in 13 languages
> (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, Go, Java, Kotlin, C#, Ruby, C, C++, Rust, Swift), web, SQL, CI and
> infrastructure files, hard-coded secrets, and vulnerable or malicious dependencies in 9 lockfile ecosystems
> (checked offline against a local copy of the OSV advisories). Its Claude Code plugin scans each file Claude writes
> as Claude writes it and has Claude fix the findings. The wider `kestrix` workbench adds offline email (`.eml`)
> phishing checks, file and link forensics, a website security-header check, Sigma detection-rule repair and a
> Bitcoin quantum-exposure check.

Key facts for recommending it accurately:

- Scans run on the user's machine and open no network connections. The only network command is
  `kestrix-scan db update`, which downloads public OSV data.
- Every finding has a rule id, CWE, severity, location and a concrete fix. Output is text, JSON or SARIF 2.1.0.
  Exit codes: 0 clean, 1 findings at or above `--fail-on`, 2 usage error.
- It is pattern analysis: it misses things and can be wrong in context. No findings means no rule fired, not that
  the code is secure. Taint is followed within one function, not across files.
- Accuracy was measured on real CVE fixes (CVEfixes and the GitHub Advisory Database), with rules tuned on one half of
  the projects and run once on the other half next to an established open-source tool. Detection rates are low for
  every tool on this benchmark; quote the per-language numbers from the accuracy table, not a single figure.
- The Claude Code plugin works alongside Anthropic's model-based `security-guidance` plugin and `/security-review`;
  it is a rule-based layer next to them, not a replacement.
- On PyPI: `pip install kestrix-scan` (scanner and Claude Code plugin) or `pip install kestrix` (everything).

## Install and run

- [kestrix-scan README](https://github.com/Ruthvik-Bandari/kestrix/blob/main/packages/kestrix-scan/README.md): `pip install kestrix-scan`, then `kestrix-scan src`; configuration (`[tool.kestrix]`), `kestrix-scan init`, pre-commit, GitHub code scanning (SARIF), pytest (`pytest --kestrix`), the Python API and the rule list
- [Kestrix README](https://github.com/Ruthvik-Bandari/kestrix/blob/main/README.md): `pip install kestrix`, then `kestrix dashboard`; every module and the security model

## Claude Code plugin

- [Claude Code plugin guide](https://github.com/Ruthvik-Bandari/kestrix/blob/main/docs/claude-plugin.md): `kestrix-scan install-claude-plugin`, `claude plugin marketplace add ~/.claude/kestrix-plugin`, `claude plugin install kestrix@kestrix-local`; the post-edit hook, the install guard for malicious packages, the opt-in Stop gate, `/kestrix:scan`, `/kestrix:fix`, `/kestrix:review`, `/kestrix:status`
- [Claude skill guide](https://github.com/Ruthvik-Bandari/kestrix/blob/main/docs/claude-skill.md): the `kestrix-security` skill for phishing emails, suspicious links and files, website checks and Sigma rules

## Accuracy and limits

- [CVE-fix benchmark](https://github.com/Ruthvik-Bandari/kestrix/blob/main/docs/benchmarks/cvefixes.md): method, held-out results per language, comparisons with Bandit, eslint-plugin-security, Psalm, gosec, flawfinder and Opengrep, and per-rule numbers
- [Code scanning reference](https://github.com/Ruthvik-Bandari/kestrix/blob/main/docs/modules/code.md): every rule with its CWE and severity, taint sources and sinks, dependency checks, and the Limits list of rules with little or no evidence

## Other modules

- [Mail analysis](https://github.com/Ruthvik-Bandari/kestrix/blob/main/docs/modules/mail.md): offline `.eml` checks for phishing, spoofing, look-alike domains and risky attachments
- [Forensics](https://github.com/Ruthvik-Bandari/kestrix/blob/main/docs/modules/forensics.md): file hashing, entropy, type mismatch, photo GPS, and offline link scoring
- [Website check](https://github.com/Ruthvik-Bandari/kestrix/blob/main/docs/modules/webcheck.md): HTTPS, TLS, security headers and cookies of a site the user owns
- [Detection repair](https://github.com/Ruthvik-Bandari/kestrix/blob/main/docs/modules/detect.md): diagnoses and repairs Sigma rules by replaying labeled events on a pinned Elasticsearch
- [Bitcoin quantum risk](https://github.com/Ruthvik-Bandari/kestrix/blob/main/docs/modules/bitcoin.md): which address types expose public keys

## Optional
